scope.statement: Stage4 closes the frozen 154-key gap inventory with evidence-bearing dispositions, appends accepted exact variants, and migrates every v2 variant to an immutable Stage4 claim number. It does not assert that all 3,338 inherited machine-triage records have completed semantic or truth-status review.

policy.stage_number_rule: The eight-digit Stage4 ordinal equals the ATV ordinal and never encodes domain, kind, status, owner, or display order.
policy.legacy_alias_rule: Every THM-* alias remains permanently bound to its historical v2 ATV; current split or redirect resolution is stored separately.
policy.allocation_rule: Only an accepted exact child allocates a new ATV. Existing-family, collision, and nonclaim dispositions allocate nothing for the umbrella key.
policy.semantic_change_rule: A binder, hypothesis, conclusion, scope, physical regime, or computation-model change creates a new ATV; labels and status events do not.
policy.split_rule: A split has no default child and inherits no evidence, proof, benchmark receipt, or status without an exact applicability review.
policy.projection_rule: The theorem and conjecture/hypothesis/open surfaces are generated queries over the catalog JSON and are never hand-maintained.
policy.source_rule: The three legacy Markdown pools remain byte-sealed. Stage4 additions are source occurrences in this structured curation authority.
policy.repair_proposal_rule: All 623 v2 domain repair proposals are conserved as proposal-only dispositions unless an explicit Stage4 overlay or child cites one; proposal presence alone grants no review or truth credit.
